tha-ap393:1.1: Avaṇṭaphalavaggo ekūnacattāriṃso. [388. Pilindavaccha.] Nagare Haṃsavatiyā āsiṃ dovāriko ahaṃ / akkhobhaṃ amitabhogaṃ ghare sannicitaṃ mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:2.1: Rahogato nisīditvā sampahaṃsitvā mānasaṃ / nisajja pāsādavare evaṃ cintes' ahan tadā: // //
tha-ap393:3.0: Bahū me 'dhigatā bhogā: phītam antepuraṃ mama / rājāpi sannimantesi Ānando puthuvissaro. // //
tha-ap393:4.1: Ayañ ca Buddho uppanno adhiccuppattiko muni / saṃvijjanti ca me bhogā; dānaṃ dassāmi satthuno. // //
tha-ap393:5.1: Padume rājaputtena dinnaṃ dānaṃ varaṃ jine / hatthināge ca pallaṅke appassenañ c' anappakaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:6.1: Aham pi dānaṃ dassāmi saṅghe guṇavaruttame / adinnapubbaṃ dānavaraṃ bhavissam ādikammiko. // //
tha-ap393:7.1: Cintetvāhaṃ bahuvidhaṃ yāge yassa sukhaṃ phalaṃ / parikkhāradānam addakkhiṃ mama saṅkappapūraṇaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:8.1: Parikkhārāna dassāmi saṅghe guṇavaruttame / adinnapubbam aññesaṃ bhavissam ādikammiko. // //
tha-ap393:9.0: Naḷakāre upāgamma chattaṃ kāresiṃ tāvade / chattasatasahassāni ekato sannipātayiṃ. // //
tha-ap393:11.1: vāsiyo satthake cāpi sūciyo nakhacchedane. // // Heṭṭhā chatte laggāpesiṃ kāretvā tadanucchave /
tha-ap393:12.1: vidhūpane tālavaṇṭe morahatthe ca cāmare. // // Parissāvane teladhāre kārayiṃ tadanuccha*ve /
tha-ap393:13.1: sūcighare aṃsabaddhe atho* pi kāyabandhane. // // Ādhārake ca sukate kārayiṃ tadanucchave /
tha-ap393:14.1: paribhogabhājane ca atho pi lohathālake. // // Bhesajjaṃ pūrayitvāna heṭṭhā chatte ṭhapes' ahaṃ /
tha-ap393:15.1: vacam usīram laṭṭhimadhuṃ pipphalī maricāni ca // // Harī*ṭakiṃ siṅgiveraṃ sabbaṃ pūresi bhājane* /
tha-ap393:16.1: upāhanā pādukāyo atho udakapuñchane. // // Kattaradaṇḍe sukate kārayiṃ tadanucchave /
tha-ap393:17.1: osadhaṃ jananāliṃ ca salākā dhammakuttarā. // // Kuñcikā pañcavaṇṇehi sibbite kuñcikāghare /
tha-ap393:18.1: āyoge dhūmanette ca atho pi dīpadhārake. // // Tumbake ca karaṇḍe ca kārayiṃ tadanucchave /
tha-ap393:19.1: saṇḍāse pipphale c' eva atho pi malahārake. // // Bhesajjathavike c' eva kārayiṃ tadanucchave /
tha-ap393:20.1: āsandiyo pīṭhake ca pallaṅke caturomaye // // tadanucchave kāretvā heṭṭhā chatte ṭhapes' ahaṃ. /
tha-ap393:21.1: Unnābhisī tūlabhisī atho pi pīṭhikābhisī // // bimbohane ca sukate kārayiṃ tadanucchave /
tha-ap393:22.1: kuruvinde madhusitthe telahatthappatāpakaṃ // // Sipāṭiphalake sucī mañcam attharaṇena ca /
tha-ap393:23.1: senāsane pādapuñche sayanāsanadaṇḍake. // // Dantapoṇe ca pāṭalī sīsālepanagandhake /
tha-ap393:24.1: araṇī palālapīṭhe ca pattapidhānadhārake. // // Udakassa katacchuñ ca cuṇṇakam rajanammanaṃ /
tha-ap393:25.1: sammajjanaṃ uda vatthaṃ tathā vassikasāṭakaṃ // // nisīdanaṃ kaṇḍucchādi atha antaravāsakaṃ /
tha-ap393:26.1: uttarāsaṅghasaṅghāṭiṃ natthukaṃ mukhasodhanaṃ // // bilaṅgaloṇaṃ bhūtaṃ ca madhuñ ca dadhipānakaṃ /
tha-ap393:27.1: pupphaṃ sitthaṃ pilotiñ ca mukhapuñchanasuttakaṃ. // // Dātabbaṃ nāma yam atthi yañ ca kappati satthuno /
tha-ap393:28.1: sabbam etam samānetvā Ānandam upasaṅkamiṃ. // // Upasaṅkamma rājānaṃ janetāraṃ mahāyasaṃ / sirasā abhivādetvā imaṃ vacanam abraviṃ: // //
tha-ap393:29.0: Ekato jātasaṃvaddhā ubhinnam ekato yasaṃ / sādhāraṇā sukkhadukkhe ubho ca anuvattakā. // //
tha-ap393:30.1: Atthi cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ tavāddheyyam arindama / yadi sakkosi naṃ dukkhaṃ vinodeyyāsi khattiya. // //
tha-ap393:31.1: Tava dukkhaṃ mama dukkham ubhinnam ekato manaṃ / niṭṭhitan ti vijānāhi mamādheyyaṃ sace tuvaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:32.1: Jānāhi kho mahārāja dukkhaṃ me dubbinodayaṃ / bahussamāno gajjassu etaṃ te duccajjaṃ dhanaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:33.1: Yāvatā vijitaṃ atthi yāvatā mama jīvitaṃ / etehi yadi te attho dassāmi avikampito. // //
tha-ap393:34.1: Gajjitaṃ kho tayā deva micchā taṃ bahugajjitaṃ / jānissāmi tavaṃ ajja sabbadhamme patiṭṭhitaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:35.1: Atibāḷhaṃ nipīḷesi dadamānassa me sato / kin te palapite n' attho; patthitaṃ te kathehi me. // //
tha-ap393:36.1: Icchām' ahaṃ mahārāja Buddhaseṭṭham anuttaraṃ / bhojayissāmi sambuddhaṃ vajjaṃ me p' āhu jīvitaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:37.1: Aññam te 'haṃ varaṃ dammi; ayācittho Tathāgataṃ / adeyyo kassaci Buddho maṇijotiraso yathā. // //
tha-ap393:38.1: Nanu te gajjitaṃ deva yāvajīvitam atthikaṃ / jivitaṃ dadamānena yuttaṃ dātuṃ Tathāgataṃ. // //
tha-ap393:39.1: Ṭhapanīyo mahāvīro adeyyo kassaci jino / na me *paṭissuto* Buddho varassu amitaṃ dhanaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:40.1: Vinicchayam pāpuṇāma pucchissāma vinicchaye / yathāsaṇhaṃ kathessanti paṭipucchāma taṃ tathā. // //
tha-ap393:41.1: Rañño hatthe gahetvāna agamāsiṃ vinicchayaṃ / purato akkhadassānam idaṃ vacanam abraviṃ: // //
tha-ap393:42.1: Sunaṇtu me akkhadassā rājā varam adāsi me / na kiñci ṭhapayitvāna jīvitam pi pavārayi. // //
tha-ap393:43.1: Tassa me varadinnassa Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ varim ahaṃ / sudinno hoti me Buddho athavā saṃsayaṃ mama. // //
tha-ap393:44.1: Sussāma tava vacanaṃ bhūmipālassa rājino / ubhinnaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā chindissām' ettha saṃsayaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:45.1: Sabbaṃ deva tayā dinnaṃ imassa sabbagāhikaṃ / na kiñci ṭhapayitvāna jīvitam pi pavārayi? // //
tha-ap393:46.1: Kicchapatto va hutvāna yācī varam anuttaraṃ / imaṃ sudukkhitaṃ ñatvā adāsiṃ sabbagāhikaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:47.1: Parājayo tavaṃ deva assa deyyo Tathāgato / ubhinnaṃ saṃsayo chinno yathāsaṇṭhamhi tiṭṭhatha. // //
tha-ap393:48.1: Rājā tatth' eva ṭhatvāna akkhadasse tad abravi: / sammā mayhaṃ pi deyyātha puna Buddhaṃ labhām' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:49.1: Pūretvā tava saṅkappaṃ bhojayitvā Tathāgataṃ / puna deyyāsi sambuddham Ānandassa yasassino. // //
tha-ap393:50.0: Akkhadasse 'bhivādetvā Ānandañ cāpi khattiyaṃ / tuṭṭho pamudito hutvā sambuddham upasaṅkamiṃ. // //
tha-ap393:51.1: Upasaṅkamma sambuddham oghatiṇṇam anāsavaṃ / sirasā abhivādetvā idaṃ vacanam abraviṃ: // //
tha-ap393:52.1: ‘Vasīsatasahassehi adhivāsehi cakkhumā / hāsayanto mamaṃ cittaṃ nivesanam upehi me.' // //
tha-ap393:53.1: Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / mama saṅkappam aññāya adhivāsesi cakkhumā. // //
tha-ap393:54.1: Adhivāsanam aññāya abhivādiya satthuno / haṭṭho udaggacitto 'haṃ nivesanam upāgamiṃ. // //
tha-ap393:55.0: Mittāmacce samānetvā idaṃ vacanam abraviṃ: / sudullabho mayā laddho maṇijotiraso yathā. // //
tha-ap393:56.1: Kena taṃ pūjayisāma? appameyyo anupamo / atulo asamo vīro jino appaṭipuggalo. // //
tha-ap393:57.1: Tathā samasamo c' eva adutiyo narāsabho / dukkaram adhikāram hi Buddhānucchavikaṃ tayā. // //
tha-ap393:58.1: Nānāpupphe samānetvā karoma pupphamaṇḍapaṃ / Buddhānucchavikaṃ etaṃ sabbapūjā bhavissati. // //
tha-ap393:59.1: Uppalaṃ padumañ cāpi vassikam atimuttakaṃ / campakaṃ nāgap*upphañ ca ma*ṇḍapaṃ kārayim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:60.1: Satāsanasahassāni chattacchāyāya paññapiṃ / pacchimam āsanaṃ mayham adhikaṃ satam agghati // //
tha-ap393:61.1: Satāsanasahassāni . . . pe . . . / paṭiyādetvā annapānaṃ kālam arocayiṃ ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:62.1: *Ārocitamhi kālamhi* Padumuttaro mahāmuni / vasīsatasahassehi nivesanam upesi me. // //
tha-ap393:63.1: Dhārentam uparicchattaṃ suphullapupphamaṇḍape / vasīsatasahassehi nisīdi purisuttamo. // //
tha-ap393:64.1: Chattasatasahassāni satasahassa-m-āsanaṃ / ka*ppiyam anavajjañ ca paṭiga*ṇhāhi cakkhumā. // //
tha-ap393:65.1: Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / maman tāretukāmo so sampaṭicchi mahāmuni. // //
tha-ap393:66.0: Bhikkhussa ekam ekassa paccekaṃ patt' adās' ahaṃ / jahiṃsu pupphakaṃ pattaṃ lohaṃ pattam adhārayuṃ. // //
tha-ap393:67.1: Sattarattindivaṃ *Buddho ni*sīdi pupphamaṇḍape / bodhayanto bahu satte dhammacakkaṃ pavattayi. // //
tha-ap393:68.1: Dhammacakkaṃ pavattento heṭṭhato pupphamaṇḍape / cullāsītisahassānaṃ dhammābhisamayo ahu. // //
tha-ap393:69.1: Sattame divase patte Padumuttaro mahāmunī / chattacchāyāya*m āsī*no imā gāthā abhāsathā: // //
tha-ap393:70.0: Anūnakaṃ dānavaraṃ yo me pādāsi māṇavo / tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato: // //
tha-ap393:71.1: Hatthī assā rathā pattī senā ca caturaṅginī / parivāressanti taṃ niccaṃ sabbadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:72.1: Hatthiyānam assayānaṃ sivikaṃ sandamānikaṃ / upaṭṭhissant' imaṃ niccaṃ sabbadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:73.1: Saṭṭhirathasahassāni sabbālaṅkārabhūsitā / parivāressant' imaṃ niccaṃ sabbadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:74.1: Saṭṭhituriyasahassāni bheriyo samalaṅkatā / vajjayissant' imaṃ niccaṃ sabbadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:76.1: Aḷārapamhāhasulā susoññā tanumajjhimā / parivāressant' imaṃ niccaṃ sabbadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:77.1: Tiṃsakappasahassāni devaloke ramissati / sahassakkhattuṃ devindo devarajjaṃ karissati. // //
tha-ap393:78.1: Sahassakkhattuṃ rājā *ca* cakkavattī bhavissati / padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:79.1: Devaloke vasantassa puññakammasamaṅgino / devalokānupariyante ratanachattaṃ dharissati. // //
tha-ap393:80.1: Icchissati yadā cāyaṃ chadanaṃ dussapupphajaṃ / imassa cittam aññāya nibaddhaṃ chādayissati. // //
tha-ap393:81.1: Devalokā cavitvāna sukkamūlena codito / puññakammena saṃyutto brahmabandhu bhavissati. // //
tha-ap393:82.1: Kappasatasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo / Gotamo nāma gottena satthā loke bhavissati. // //
tha-ap393:83.1: Sabbam etam abhiññāya Gotamo Sakyapuṅgavo / bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā etadagge ṭhapessati. // //
tha-ap393:84.1: Pilindavaccho nām*ena* hessati satthu sāvako / devānam asurānañ ca gandhabbānañ ca sakkato. // //
tha-ap393:85.1: Bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnañ ca gihīnañ ca tath' eva so / piyo hutvāna sabbesaṃ viharissat' anāsavo. // //
tha-ap393:86.0: Satasahasse kataṃ kammaṃ phalaṃ dassesi me idha / sumutto saravego ca kilese jhāpayissati. // //
tha-ap393:87.1: Aho me sukataṃ kammaṃ puññakkhette anuttare / yatthakāraṃ karitvāna patto 'mhi acalaṃ padaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:88.1: Anūnakaṃ dānavaram adāsi yo hi māṇavo / ādipubbaṅgamo āsiṃ tassa dānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:89.0: Chatte sugate datvāna saṅghe {guṇavaruttame} / aṭṭhānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mama. // //
tha-ap393:90.1: Sītaṃ uṇhaṃ na jānāmi rajojallaṃ na lippati / anupaddavo anītī ca homi apacito sadā. // //
tha-ap393:91.1: Sukhumacchaviko homi visadaṃ hoti mānasaṃ / chattasatasahassāni bhave saṃsarato mama. // //
tha-ap393:92.1: Sabbālaṅkārayuttāni tassa kammassa vāhasā / idaṃ jātiṃ ṭhapetvāna matthake dhārayanti me. // //
tha-ap393:93.1: Tasmā imāya jātiyā n' atthi me chattadhāraṇā / mama sabbaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ vimutticchattapattiyā. // //
tha-ap393:94.0: Dussāni sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame / aṭṭhānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mama. // //
tha-ap393:95.1: Suvaṇṇavaṇṇo virajo sappabhāso patāpavā / siniddhaṃ hoti me gattaṃ bhave saṃsarato mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:96.1: Dussasatasahassāni setā pītā ca lohitā / dhārenti matthake mayhaṃ dussadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:97.1: Koseyyakambalīyāni khomakappāsikāni ca / sabbattha paṭilābhāmi tesaṃ nissandato ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:98.0: Patte sugate datvāna saṅghe guṇavaruttame / dasānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mama. // //
tha-ap393:99.1: Suvaṇṇathāle maṇithāle rajate pi ca thālake / lohitaṅkamaye thāle paribhuñjāmi sabbadā. // //
tha-ap393:100.1: Anupaddavo anītī ca homi apacito sadā / lābhī annassa pānassa vatthassa sayanassa ca. // //
tha-ap393:101.1: Na vinassanti me bhogā; ṭhitacitto bhavām' ahaṃ / dhammakāmo sadā bhomi 'ppakileso anāsavo. // //
tha-ap393:102.1: Devaloke manusse vā anubaddhā ime guṇā / chāyā yathāpi rukkhassa sabbattha na jahanti maṃ // //
tha-ap393:103.0: Cittabandhanasambaddhā sukatā vāsiyo bahū / datvāna Buddhaseṭṭhassa saṅghassa ca tath' ev' ahaṃ /
tha-ap393:104.1: aṭṭhānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mama. // // Sūro homi visālī ca vesārajjesu pāramī /
tha-ap393:105.1: dhitiviriyavā homi paggahītamano sadā. // // Kilesacchedanaṃ ñāṇam sukhumam atulaṃ suciṃ / sabbattha paṭilābhāmi tassa nissandato mama. // //
tha-ap393:106.0: Aka*kkase apha*ruse adhote satthake bahū / pasannacitto datvāna Buddhasaṅghe tath' eva ca /
tha-ap393:107.1: pañcānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mama. // // Kalyāṇacittaṃ viriyaṃ khantiñ ca mettasatthakaṃ /
tha-ap393:108.1: taṇhāsallassa chinnattā pañ*ñāsattham anuttaraṃ / vaji*rena samaṃ ñāṇaṃ tesaṃ nissandato labhe. // //
tha-ap393:109.0: Sūciyo sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame / pañcānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mama. // //
tha-ap393:110.1: Namassiyo kaṅkhachedo abhirūpo ca bhogavā / tikkhapañño *sadā homi saṃsaranto bhavābhave.* // //
tha-ap393:111.1: Gambhīraṃ nipuṇaṃ ṭhānam attha-ñāṇena passayiṃ / vajiraggasamaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti me tamaghāṭanaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:112.0: Nakhacchedane sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame / pañcānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:113.1: Dāsidāse gavasse ca bhata*ke ārakkhe bahū* / nahāpite bhatake sūde sabbatth' eva labhām' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:114.0: Vidhūpane sugate datvā tālavaṇṭe ca sobhane / aṭṭhānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mama. // //
tha-ap393:115.1: Sītam uṇhaṃ na jānāmi pariḷāho na vijjati / darathaṃ nābhijānāmi cittasantāpanaṃ mama. // //
tha-ap393:116.1: *Rāgaggi do*samohaggi mānaggi diṭṭhiaggi ca / sabbaggī nibbutā mayhaṃ tassa nissandato mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:117.0: Morahatthe cāmariyo datvā saṅghe gaṇuttame / upasantakileso 'haṃ viharāmi anaṅgaṇo. // //
tha-ap393:118.0: Parissāvane sugate datvā saṅghe gaṇuttame / pañcānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:119.1: Sabbesaṃ samatikkamma dibbam āyuṃ labhām' ahaṃ / appasayho sadā homi corapaccatthikehi vā. // //
tha-ap393:120.1: Satthena vā visena vā vihesam pi na kubbate / antarāmāraṇaṃ n' atthi tesaṃ nissandato mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:121.0: Teladhāre sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame / pañcānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:122.1: Sucārurūpo sugato susamuggatamānaso / avikkhittamano homi sabbārakkhehi rakkhito. // //
tha-ap393:123.0: Sūcighare sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame / tīṇānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:124.1: Cetosukhaṃ kāyasukham iriyāpathajaṃ sukhaṃ / ime guṇe paṭilabhāmi tassa nissandato ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:125.0: Aṃsabaddhe jine datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame / tīṇānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mama. // //
tha-ap393:126.1: Saddhamme gādhaṃ vindāmi sarāmi dutiyaṃ bhavaṃ / sabbattha succhavī homi tassa nissandato ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:127.0: Kāyabandhe sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame / chānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // // Samādhisu
tha-ap393:128.1: na kaṅkhāmi vasī homi samādhisu / abhejjapariso homi ādeyyavacano sadā. // //
tha-ap393:129.1: Upaṭṭhitasatī homi tāso mayhaṃ na vijjati / devaloke manusse vā anubaddhā ime guṇā. // //
tha-ap393:130.0: Ādhārake jine datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame / pañcavaṇṇehi dāyādo acalo homi kenaci. // //
tha-ap393:131.1: Ye keci me sutā dhammā satiñāṇappabodhanā / *va*tā me na vinassanti bhavanti suvinicchitā. // //
tha-ap393:132.0: Bhājane paribhoge ca datvā Buddhegaṇuttame / tīṇānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // // Sovaṇṇamaye
tha-ap393:133.1: maṇimaye atho pi phalikāmaye / lohitaṅkamaye c' eva labhāmi bhājane ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:134.1: Bhariyā dāsadāsī ca hatthassarathapattike / itthī patibbatā c' eva paribhogādisampadā. // //
tha-ap393:135.1: Vijjā mantapade c' eva vividhe āgame bahū / sabbaṃ sippan nisāmemi paribhogādisampadā. // //
tha-ap393:136.0: Thālake sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame / tīṇānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // // Sovaṇṇamaye
tha-ap393:137.1: maṇimaye atho pi phalikāmaye / lohitaṅkamaye c' eva labhāmi thālake ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:138.1: Assatthake phalamaye atho pokkharapattake / madhupānakasaṅkhe ca labhāmi thālake ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:139.1: Vatte guṇe paṭilabhe ācārakiriyāsu ca / ime guṇe paṭilabhe tassa nissandato ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:140.0: Bhesajje sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame / dasānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // // Āyuvā
tha-ap393:141.1: balavā vīro vaṇṇavā yasavā sukhī / anupaddavo anītī ca bhomi cāpacito sadā. / Na me piyaviyog' atthi tassa nissandato mama. // //
tha-ap393:142.0: Upāhane jine datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame / tīṇānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // // Hatthiyānam
tha-ap393:143.1: assayānaṃ sivikaṃ sandamānikaṃ / saṭṭhiṃ satasahassāni parivārenti maṃ sadā. // //
tha-ap393:144.1: Maṇimayā maṇḍalakā sovaṇṇarajatapādukā / nibbattanti paduddhāre bhave saṃsarato mama. // //
tha-ap393:145.1: Niyamaṃ paṭidhāvanti ācāraguṇasodhanaṃ / ime guṇe paṭilabhe tassa nissandato ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:146.0: Pāduke sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame / iddhipādukam āruyha viharāmi yadicchakaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:147.0: Mukhapuñchanacole ca datvā Buddhe gaṇuttame / pañcānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // // Suvaṇṇavaṇṇo
tha-ap393:148.1: virajo sappabhāso patāpavā / siniddhaṃ hoti me gattaṃ rajojallaṃ na lippati. / Ime guṇe paṭilabhe tassa nissandato ahaṃ // //
tha-ap393:149.0: Kattaradaṇḍe sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame / chānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // // Puttā
tha-ap393:150.1: mayhaṃ bahū honti tāso mayhaṃ na vijjati / appasayho sadā homi sabbārakkhehi rakkhito / calitaṃ maṃ *na jānāmi* āgataṃ mānasaṃ mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:151.0: Osadham añjanaṃ datvā Buddhe saṅghe gaṇuttame / aṭṭhānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // // Visālanayano
tha-ap393:153.1: labhāmi dibbanayanaṃ paññācakkhum anuttaraṃ / ime guṇe paṭilabhe tassa nissandato ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:154.0: Kuñcike sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame / dhammadvāravivaraṇaṃ labhāmi ñāṇakuñcikaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:155.0: Kuñcikānaṃ ghare datvā *Buddhe saṅghe . . . pe . . .* / dvānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // // appakodho anāyāso saṃsaranto bhave ahaṃ.
tha-ap393:156.0: Āyoge sugate datvā saṅghe . . . pe . . . / pañcānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // // Samādhisu
tha-ap393:157.1: na *kampāmi vasī homi* samādhisu / abhejjapariso homi ādeyyavacano sadā / Jāticca bhogasampatti bhave saṃsarato mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:158.0: Dhūmanette jine datvā saṅghe . . . pe . . . / tīṇānisaṃsā . . . pe . . . // //
tha-ap393:159.1: Sati *me ujukā hoti susa*mbaddhā ca nahāruyo / labhāmi dibbanayanaṃ tassa nissandato ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:160.0: Dīpathāle jine datvā saṅghe . . . pe . . . / tīṇānusaṃsānubhomi . . . pe . . . // //
tha-ap393:161.1: Jātimā aṅgasampanno pañña*vā Bu*ddhasammato / ime guṇe paṭilabhe tassa nissandato ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:162.0: Tumbake ca karaṇḍe ca datvā Buddhe gaṇuttame / dasānisaṃsānubhomi . . . pe . . . // // Sadā
tha-ap393:163.1: gutto sukhasamaṅgī mahāyasavā tathāgattī / bhattikato sukhumālo sabbītiparivajjito. // //
tha-ap393:164.1: Vipule ca guṇe lābhī samāvacaraṇā mama / suvivajjitaubbego tumbake ca karaṇḍake. // //
tha-ap393:165.1: Labhāmi caturo vaṇṇe hatthassā ratanāni ca / tāni me na vinassanti tumbadāne idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:166.0: Hatthī līlaṅgake datvā Buddhe saṅghe . . . pe . . . / pañcānisaṃsānubhomi . . . pe . . . // //
tha-ap393:167.1: Sabbalakkhaṇasampanno āyupaññāsamāhito / sabbāyāsavinimutto kāyo me hoti sabbadā. // //
tha-ap393:168.0: Tanudhāre sunisite saṅghe datvāna pipphale / kilesakantanaṃ ñāṇaṃ labhāmi atulaṃ suciṃ // //
tha-ap393:169.0: Saṇḍāse sugate datvā saṅghe . . . pe . . . / kilesaluñcanaṃ ñāṇaṃ labhāmi atulaṃ suciṃ. // //
tha-ap393:170.0: Natthuke sugate datvā . . . pe . . . / aṭṭhānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // //
tha-ap393:171.1: Saddhaṃ sīlaṃ hiriñ cāpi atho ottappiyaṃ guṇaṃ / sukhañ cāgañ ca khantiñ ca paññaṃ me aṭṭhamaṃ guṇaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:172.0: Pīṭhake sugate datvā . . . pe . . . / pañcānisaṃsānubhomi . . . pe . . . pe . . . // //
tha-ap393:173.1: Ucce kule pajāyāmi mahābhogo bhavām' ahaṃ / sabbe mam apacāyanti kitti abbhuggatā mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:174.1: Kappasatasahassāni pallaṅkā caturassarā / parivāressanti maṃ niccaṃ saṃvibhāgarato ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:175.0: Bhisiyo sugate datvā . . . pe . . . / chānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // // samaṃ
tha-ap393:176.1: sambhatto 'pacito muduko cārudassano / labhāmi ñāṇaparivāraṃ bhisidānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:177.1: Tūlikā vikatikāyo kaṭṭhissā cittikā bahū / varapotthake kambale ca labhāmi vividhe ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:178.1: Pāvārike ca muduke mudukā jinaveṇiyo / labhāmi vividhatthāre bhisidānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:179.1: Yato sarāmi attānaṃ yato patto 'smi viññutaṃ / atucchojjhānamañño 'mhi bhisidānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:180.0: Bimbohane jine datvā . . . pe . . . / chānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // //
tha-ap393:181.1: Uṇṇike padumake ca atho lohitacandane / bimbohane uppādemi uttamaṅgaṃ sadā mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:182.1: Aṭṭhaṅgike maggavare sāmaññe caturo phale / tesu ñāṇaṃ upānetvā vihāre niccakālikaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:183.1: Dāne dame saññame ca appamaññesu rūpisu / tesu ñāṇam upānetvā vihāre sabbakālikaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:184.1: Vatte guṇe ca pañcame ācārakiriyāsu ca / ñāṇaṃ uppādayitvāna vihāre sabbadā ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:185.1: Caṅkame vā padhāne vā viriye bodhapakkhike / tesu ñāṇam upānetvā viharāmi yadicchakaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:186.1: Sīlaṃ samādhi paññā ca vimutti ca anuttarā / tesu ñāṇam upānetvā viharāmi sukham ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:187.0: Palālapīṭhe jine datvā . . . pe . . . / caturānisaṃse . . . pe . . . // //
tha-ap393:188.1: Sovaṇṇamaye maṇimaye dantasāramaye bahū / pallaṅkaseṭṭhe vindāmi palālapīṭhass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:189.0: Pādapīṭhe jine datvā . . . pe . . . / dvānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // // Labhāmi bahuke yāne pādapīṭhass' idaṃ phalaṃ /
tha-ap393:190.1: dāsidāsā ca bhariyā ye c' aññe anujīvino / Sammā paricarante maṃ pādapīṭhass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:191.0: Telān' abbhañjane datvā . . . pe . . . / pañcānisaṃse . . . pe . . . // //
tha-ap393:192.1: Abyādhitā rūpavatā khippaṃ dhammanisantitā / lābhitā annapānassa āyu pañcamakaṃ mama // //
tha-ap393:193.0: Sappitelañ ca datvāna saṅghe . . . pe . . . / pañcānisaṃse . . . pe . . . // //
tha-ap393:194.1: Thāmavā rūpasampanno pahaṭṭhatanujo sadā / avyādhī visajī homi sappitelass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:195.0: Mukhadhovanakaṃ datvā Buddhe saṅghe . . . pe . . . / pañcānisaṃsānubhomi . . . pe . . . // // Visuddhakaṇṭho
tha-ap393:196.1: madhurassaro kāsassāsavivajjito / upphalagandho mukhato upavāyati me sadā. // //
tha-ap393:197.0: Dadhiṃ datvāna sampannaṃ Buddhe saṅghe . . . pe . . . / bhuñjāmi *amataṃ cittaṃ varakāy*agataṃ
tha-ap393:198.0: satiṃ // // Vaṇṇagandharasopetaṃ madhuṃ datvā jine gaṇe / Anupamam atuliyam pive muttirasam ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:199.0: Yathābhūtaṃ rasaṃ datvā Buddhe saṅghe . . . pe . . . / caturo phale anubhomi kammānucchavike mama. // //
tha-ap393:200.0: Annapānañ ca datvāna saṅghe . . . pe . . . / dasānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . . // //
tha-ap393:201.1: Āyuvā balavā vīro vaṇṇavā yasavā sukhī / lābhī annassa pānassa sūro paññāṇavā tathā / ime guṇe paṭilabhe saṃsaranto bhave ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:202.0: Dhūmaṃ datvā sugate saṅghe . . . pe . . . / dasānisaṃsānubhomi . . . pe . . . // //
tha-ap393:203.1: Sugandhadeho yasavā sīghapañño ca kittimā / tikkhapañño bhūripañño bhāsagambhīrapaññavā. // //
tha-ap393:204.1: Vepullajavanappañño saṃsaranto bhavābhave / tass' eva vāhasā dāni patto santisukhaṃ sivaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:206.1: Sāgataṃ vata me āsi mama Buddhassa santike / tisso vijjā anuppatto kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanaṃ. // //
tha-ap393:207.1: Kilesā jhāpitā mayhaṃ bhavā sabbe samūhatā / nāgo va bandhanaṃ chetvā viharāmi anāsavo. // //
tha-ap393:208.1: Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . // // Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Pilindavaccho thero i. g. a-ti.
